newsitem.title: USA: ATC Communications names Arthur Chavoya CEO.
newsitem.headline: ATC Communications names Arthur Chavoya CEO.

text.p: ATC Communications Inc said on Wednesday it named Arthur Chavoya president and chief executive officer to replace Michael Santry, who will become chairman of the board.
Chavoya was previously president of Electronic Data Systems Corp's Global Travel Services Industry strategic business unit, the company said in a statement.
Chavoya would assume his role effective September 23, the company said.
The chairman position has been vacant for the past two years, an ATC spokesman said.
Tom Bijou, who was president of the company's operating subsidiary, would remain a director of ATC and become chairman of the operating subsidiary, Santry said in a statement.

"ATC is entering a new phase in its business life cycle," he said. "Tom (Bijou) will remain a director of ATC as well as assume the position of chairman of the operating subsidiary while working with Arthur to transition ATC into our next generation of growth."

At EDS, Chavoya was responsible for business improvements through the innovative use of information services in the travel industry, ATC said. He would also serve on the company's board of directors, it said.
